The pointed projection is shortened by 1 mm to widen the small opposite margin. Land texture changes to fewer vertical 13 mm strokes, consistently in both panels; it is a learned land cue, not a crop or vegetation pattern. Both 75 mm square frames are view crops, not additional coasts.
